items.name: Review prompt
items.value: You are a strict reviewer. Read this diff and list only real bugs, each with the file, the line and a one-line fix. If there are none, answer 'No findings'.

items.name: Hook script
items.value:
#!/bin/sh
git diff --cached | uv run diff-reviewer || exit 1

items.name: Save the hook as .git/hooks/pre-commit and make it executable
example-org/diff-reviewer
